Reason for Mistake: The Planner entered a redundant verification loop after authoritative sources (e.g., Nelvana’s official contact page listing Corus Quay, 25 Dockside Drive, Toronto) had already confirmed the HQ city. Despite WebSurfer surfacing sufficient evidence by step 6, the Planner continued to instruct repeated re-verifications, treating the HQ as unsettled and delaying synthesis of the final answer (Casa Loma). This failure to finalize verified information led to unnecessary repetition and stalled delivery of the solution.
